flip_fix.v2_v3_regression_root_cause: Kernel starts /init without /dev/console (fds 0..2 closed). Adding kfd=open('/dev/kmsg',...) before /tmp/ui-report.txt occupied fd 0, shifting ui-report.txt open() to fd 1; subsequent dup2(1,1); dup2(1,2); close(1) closed stdout (fd 1) in PID1 (causing all printf/puts to fail with EBADF and ui-report.txt=0B) and caused navigation_start's log=open('/tmp/ui-keys.txt') to also get fd 1 and close(1) in the bridge child, where /dev/input/event0 (O_RDONLY) took fd 1 and made dprintf(1,'keys_diagnostic_ready=1\n') fail with EBADF while pid=24 stayed alive in poll().

candidate_v4.fix: Reserve fds 0..2 on /dev/null right after devtmpfs mount, move kfd>=3 via fcntl(F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC,3), and guard close(fd) with if(fd>2)close(fd); add report_sizes ui/keys/child mark and regression test test_stdio_fds_reserved_before_kmsg_and_report_dup2
